sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: This letter presents a 5.1–5.9 GHz PA in 0.5-µm GaAs pHEMT. The PA adopts the proposed folded DAT filtering series combiner and achieves a good output power with filtering response. By applying the filtering combiner, the PA achieves a 62.5 dBc third harmonic suppression. Through the method of folding, the combiner shrinks from 700 × 440 to 700 × 273 µm2, a 38% reduction.
